setting.pythonPath: Path to Python with tree-sitter, its grammars, and networkx. In VS Code Flatpak it runs on the host through flatpak-spawn.
setting.baselinePath: Baseline directory for detecting new cycles and dependencies; absolute or relative to the open folder.
setting.policyPath: Layer policy JSON file; requires baselinePath.
setting.analyzeOnSave: Update the analysis when a file in the selected folder is saved.
setting.language: SafeCode Studio interface language. Auto follows the VS Code display language.
